commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Celta Vigo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+5' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Alaves are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
89' Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle. Moussa Diarra (Alaves) commits a foul after dangerous play.
87' Damian Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
84' 2 - 1 Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the right side of the goal.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Asier Villalibre (Alaves) comes onto the pitch for Kike Garcia.
80' Here is a change. Ander Guevara is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Benavidez (Alaves).

80' What a huge chance for Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
78' A substitution has been made. Anastasios Douvikas is replaced by Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo).
78' The attendance is 22477.
76' Some patient build-up play from Celta Vigo as they look to unlock the defence.
72' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
68' It's time for a substitution. Stoichkov (Alaves) comes on in place of Jon Guridi.
68' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Luis Rioja (Alaves) replaces Tomas Conechny.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
66' Substitution. Fran Beltran leaves the pitch and is replaced by Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo).
65' Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Antonio Sivera.
64' One of the Alaves players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul.

63' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Celta Vigo are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
61' Referee Alejandro Quintero halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Claudio Giraldez, then shows him a yellow.
60' Celta Vigo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Substitution. Luka Romero is replaced by Hugo Novoa Ramos (Alaves).
56' A spell of possession for Alaves in an attempt to control the game.
52' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' A player from Alaves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Antonio Blanco (Alaves). Alejandro Quintero saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
46' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Jailson comes on the pitch for Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Claudio Giraldez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo). He is replaced by Williot Swedberg.
46' Claudio Giraldez makes a switch. Javier Rodriguez is coming on in place of Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+7' The Celta Vigo players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
45+2' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
45' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Celta Vigo players look gutted.
44' The Celta Vigo players halt their celebrations as referee Alejandro Quintero makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
43' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
40' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
39' Celta Vigo keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
38' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
36' The corner is swung in but Celta Vigo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
34' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
32' One of the Celta Vigo players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
27' Celta Vigo hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
23' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
21' A player from Alaves commits a rough challenge. Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
20' Alaves are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
17' 0 - 1 Kike Garcia (Alaves) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the right post. Excellent finish.

16' Celta Vigo are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
13' Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game. One of the players from Alaves won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
11' Some great controlled play and passing from Celta Vigo. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
9' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly changes the colour of the card shown to Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) to a yellow. Play continues.

7' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo), but referee Alejandro Quintero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) is really surprised after seeing a red card for his tackle. That's a harsh decision.
4' Celta Vigo string together a series of short passes.
3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
1' Ander Guevara (Alaves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Quintero saw the whole situation.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Alaves will have the kick-off.
Alejandro Quintero will supervise the game today.
